title: Quick Play + bot fill
body: menu.gd _quick_join(true) falls back to a bot match; main.gd bot fill (--fill=N, default 8 on dedicated), team-aware, never removes the flag carrier.

title: Leaderboard
body: ranked.gd reports per-round deltas to master /report (loopback or SOLDAT_STATS_KEY); Settings.profile_id hashed; leaderboard_panel.gd.

title: Lag compensation
body: player.gd pos_hist / hitbox_at; bullet.gd lag_ms rewound segment test, capped 200 ms.

title: Rambo Bow kills the archer
body: bullet.gd: own rounds pass through the shooter.

title: Remote players wear your cosmetics
body: player.gd net_cosmetics; host mirrors to joiners.

title: Kill cam, map vote, gamepad radio/loadout, helmet finishes
body: spectator.gd killcam; main.gd next_map_*; radio_menu/weapon_menu pad input; gostek FINISHES.
